short.en: Counting with only yes and no

t.zh: 回到棋盘城市：只能往右或往下走。这次不问有几条路线，只问路线数是奇数还是偶数。表里只存「是 / 否」：「是」表示奇数。
t.en: Back to the grid city: only right or down. This time the question is not how many routes there are, but whether the number is odd or even. The table holds only yes / no: “yes” means odd.

t.zh: 你手里只有「是 / 否」的元件：任一是、取反、放行闸、拦截闸。
t.en: You only have the yes / no parts: any-yes, Not, the Pass gate and the Block gate.

goal.zh: 让每个路口存「到这里的路线数是不是奇数」。起点算 1 条，是奇数。
goal.en: Make every crossing hold “is the number of routes to here odd?”. The start counts as 1 route, which is odd.

body.zh: 「正好一个是」叫异或。你只用任一是、取反和放行闸，就把它拼了出来。
body.en: “Exactly one is yes” is called XOR, and you built it from any-yes, Not and Pass gates alone.

body.zh: 表的一格不必存完整的数，只要存问题需要的那一点。奇偶只要 1 位就够了。
body.en: A cell need not hold the whole number, only the part the question needs. Odd or even takes a single bit.

hints.zh: 奇 + 奇 = 偶，奇 + 偶 = 奇：上面和左边怎样搭配时，这里才是奇数？
hints.en: Odd + odd = even, odd + even = odd: which mix of up and left makes a crossing odd?

hints.zh: 城外送来的是「—」，可在这里它应该算偶数（0 条路线）。只接一个输入的「任一是」，会把「—」变成「否」。
hints.en: Outside the city you get “—”, but here it should count as even (0 routes). An any-yes with a single input turns “—” into “no”.
